name: workthreads
description: SpecStory Workthreads - a weekly work-thread rollup across a team's repos from SpecStory coding histories (any agent - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, and more). It groups the window's sessions into threads of work per project and labels each new / open / recently closed, so a lead sees what shipped, what is still an open loop, and what was just started. author: specstoryai
summary_zh: 一款汇总团队各代码仓库编程记录的周报工具，按项目梳理进展，帮助负责人快速掌握已完成、进行中和新启动的工作。
